question_record.context: A security incident involved the 'Kekeo' malware detected during lateral movement on the device `vnevado-win10b`. Subsequently, multiple dual-purpose tools were dropped on the same device. Later, a separate incident occurred where a user clicked on a link in a ZAP-quarantined email. Can you identify the name of the user related to this incident?
question_record.question: A user clicked on a link in an email that was quarantined by zero-hour auto purge (ZAP). Can you identify the name of the user who accessed this link?
solution: The malware `rubeus.exe` (associated with 'Kekeo') was detected on the device at `2024-07-04 22:35:04.098458+00:00`. An attacker might be attempting to move laterally to this device from another device on the network.

Multiple public tools which could potentially be used for malicious purposes were dropped on the device around `2024-07-04 22:35:02.325756+00:00`, by the user with AadUserId `1d94aaf6-efe6-4e76-ad56-ffd7d1257bc1`.
The user `Ethan Brooks` accessed a link in an email that was quarantined by zero-hour auto purge (ZAP) on `2024-07-10 11:24:45.448724+00:00`.

Multiple known public tools, which could also be used for malicious reasons were dropped on this device.
Attackers might download or copy multiple dual-purpose tools to the target device to perform various attack stages including, credential theft, privilege escalation, and lateral movement.

141.name: User accessed link in ZAP-quarantined email
141.description: A user clicked on a link in an email that was quarantined by zero-hour auto purge (ZAP). This alert was triggered based on a Microsoft Defender for Office 365 alert.

interpretation.scope: official graph witness, not a proof of causality, actor identity or autonomous planning

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Account_AAD_ID' AND o.Concept = 'File_Name'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
